[1/2] Audio cycle: boss/engagement voices, captions, clip hook, WAV/spectrogram evidence and same-hash played runs

impact_assessment.why: Boss windup/slam and engagement events were silent; only the visual telegraph warned the player.
impact_assessment.benefits: Audible boss/engagement cues plus visible captions improve reaction time and accessibility.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: snapshot unchanged (boss_down is an event only); dependency: probe uses numpy/Pillow already pinned; concurrency: none; state: caption timer is presentation-only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pin event-to-voice/caption tests, same-hash played-run parity, voice cap/drop counts and a 0 px spawn regression.

[1/2] Progression cycle: versioned atomic profile, BEST HUD, run debrief, schema/quarantine tests, death pair and same-hash run

impact_assessment.why: No state outlived a launch; bests and last run were lost and death showed only YOU DIED.
impact_assessment.benefits: Persistent personal bests, run count and a post-run debrief without touching gameplay balance.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: ShooterGame gains profile_path and persisted state; dependency: keystone.serialization only; concurrency: two processes could save; state: unsupported schema must not be overwritten.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Atomic replace + .bak + lock, schema refusal disables saving, corrupt quarantine, temp profiles in every evidence script and test.
